result.reason: The redline minimally extends the Deliverable warranty to the 90-day fallback and preserves the repair/re-perform/replace/refund remedies. However, it does not include the required compliance-with-laws or no-malicious-code warranties, and it does not establish the required 30-day fallback duration for Services. Sections 19.1 and 19.2 also leave ambiguity because Section 19.1 contains an undated Services and Deliverables conformance warranty while Section 19.2 imposes a 90-day period only for Deliverables.
